messages:
Iris (Finance): @channel launching a new billing feature next quarter: Burst Reserve & Auto-Replenish. Goal: give customers a predictable short-term buffer for sudden traffic bursts while making overage charging clearer. Cutover planned: 2026-10-01 UTC.

Iris (Finance): Short summary: accounts may opt into a Reserve Buffer (configurable size) that automatically replenishes when depleted. Replenishments can be paid via invoice charge or charged to on-file payment method. Reserve usage is shown as separate invoice lines (reserve_usage, reserve_replenish).

Ken (Billing): Mechanics: reserve_capacity is set per account. When reserve is consumed, billing emits billing.event.reserve_debit.v1; if auto-replenish=true, billing emits billing.event.reserve_replenish.v1 and creates a replenish invoice line. If auto-replenish=false, requests are deprioritized but not blocked.

Ken (Billing): Preview job: data team produce CSV by 2026-08-20. Columns: account_id, suggested_reserve (units), likely_replenish_count, auto_replenish_recommended (bool), migration_id. We'll use historical 90-day spikes to suggest reserve sizes.

Maya (Product): Comms plan: console banner + a Reserve Settings panel where customers can preview suggested reserve and toggle auto-replenish. We'll ship a simulator that shows projected replenish counts and estimated monthly cost impact. Draft console copy below.

Maya (Product): Console snippet: `Enable a Reserve Buffer to absorb short bursts. We recommend a buffer equal to 20% of your monthly allotment based on recent activity. Auto-Replenish charges are billed as separate invoice lines and are reversible via dispute if triggered in error.`

Leo (Support): Support playbook: - If a customer sees unexpected replenish charges, run the replenish-audit tool and include `migration_id`. - If within 7-day dispute window, open dispute and tag billing@. - If customer wants to opt-out after a replenish, disable auto-replenish and offer a one-time reversal review.

Yara (Legal): Legal notes: replenishments charged to payment method require clear consent in settings UI. We'll add short consent copy and require a click-through for auto-replenish. Reversals are subject to dispute rules. Draft legal line: "By enabling Auto-Replenish you authorize charges to your payment method for reserve top-ups; disputes handled per billing policy."

Ken (Billing): Engineering headers: add `X-Reserve-Remaining`, `X-Reserve-Replenish-Triggered:true|false`, and include `migration_id` on invoice metadata. Also add `/billing/reserve-preview` endpoint for the console.

ops-billing-bot: reserve_preview_job queued -> scheduled 2026-08-20T05:00:00Z

Iris (Finance): Timeline: - 2026-08-20: preview CSV to billing/support/product - 2026-09-01: Reserve settings live in console (beta) - 2026-10-01: default launch (opt-out available). Monitoring: if >0.5% of active accounts dispute replenish charges in the first 72h, we will auto-pause auto-replenish globally and investigate.

Leo (Support): Sample reply: "Hi <customer>, we see an auto-replenish charge on your account. We can open a dispute and run the replenish-audit. If you prefer, we can disable Auto-Replenish going forward.  Leo, Support"

Ken (Billing): Action items: data -> preview CSV by 2026-08-20; eng -> /billing/reserve-preview + headers by 2026-09-01; product -> console UI by 2026-09-01; legal -> final consent copy by 2026-08-10; support -> training by 2026-09-05.

Iris (Finance): Thanks team. If anyone wants to test with a demo account, DM me and I'll allocate a migration_id and a seed reserve.
